start: ^I was just walking in from the fields. I had my holiday clothes on, ready for the evening feast.
^Then the centurion's spear tapped my shoulder. No choice. No argument. They forced me to pick up the wet timber.
^The wood was rough—splinters tearing into my chest, the blood from his back soaking right into my tunic.

s: ^Did he speak to you while you carried it?
^How did the crowd react along the path?
